matched.writerRule: Use at most one supplied owner-corpus foundation as a natural warmth beat. Preserve its meaning without forcing its wording.
matched.judgeRule: Judge a supplied warmth beat for naturalness and fidelity. Do not require verbatim reuse.

none_found.writerRule: Keep the register plain. Do not invent a permission, reassurance, benediction, or turn-toward-the-reader line to imitate owner warmth.
none_found.judgeRule: Do not require or penalize the absence of a permission, reassurance, benediction, or turn-toward-the-reader line. Flag invented imitation warmth when it appears.
none_found.editorialFlag: Revisit non-blockingly if future owner writing covers this emotional core.

vocabulary_only.writerRule: Use any supplied foundation only to guide ordinary word choice. Do not add a permission, reassurance, benediction, or turn-toward-the-reader sentence to short copy.
vocabulary_only.judgeRule: Do not require a warmth beat on short copy. Judge any supplied foundation only as vocabulary guidance, and flag an added imitation-warmth sentence.

not_supplied.writerRule: Do not infer or manufacture an owner warmth requirement.
not_supplied.judgeRule: Do not infer a warmth requirement from the surface or from unrelated owner examples.

aspectHumanMoment.rule: A missing human-moment beat is the only remaining fail-closed warmth-harvest case. It blocks a complete aspect entry and creates an editorial-data flag. It never demands new owner prose or an owner-corpus warmth line.
